description: Advanced pointer control (hover, click, double_click, drag_and_drop, hover_chain). Use hover_chain for Photoshop/Photopea, Figma, and multi-level flyout submenus.

action.description: Action to perform (default: click, or hover_chain if hover_chain array is provided).

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

chain.description: Advanced chain step array of { action, ref, label, selector, x, y, holdMs }.

clickFinal.description: Default true. Whether to click the final element in the hover chain.

end_target.description: Alternative destination target identifier or query.

holdMs.description: Milliseconds to hold the pointer down (only for hover).

hover_chain.description: Array of element ref IDs, selectors, or labels to hover sequentially and click the last one (e.g. ['File', 'Export As', 'PNG']). Perfect for Photoshop/Photopea, Figma, Canva, and multi-level flyout submenus.

id.description: Alternative element ID / Ref ID from browser_map.

ref.description: Ref ID of the target element (e.g. w:42).

selector.description: CSS Selector of the target element.

target.description: Alternative target element identifier or query.

waitForChild.description: CSS Selector of a child element to wait for (only for hover).

name: browser_pointer
